role.scope: independent source-only synthetic research contribution on existing PR #1327

question: Can eight non-token local metaplastic cells and four adjacent-pair support cells improve sequential A→B→A causal retention against trained soft-switching Bayes, rolling and identical-no-neighbor ablation, without phase labels, task IDs, replay, growing cell population or a global hidden-state controller?
predecessor: KNOW32 failed: archive lost to stronger approximate HMM and did not preserve live old-A state in 14/24 despite full physical support. New candidate is local context-specific Beta cells with neighbor-only support evidence, NOT the earlier global six-map×256-table archive. All KNOW32 HELD seeds/outcomes consumed; no reuse.

source.training_prior: Every arm starts identical Beta(1,1) for each of 8 public physical-input cells; absolutely no external labelled FIT. Public action affordance x=c XOR (a<<1) is identical, explicit to ALL models, and isolates continual-memory mechanism rather than unknown motor grounding.
source.law_A: x0 XOR x1 XOR (x0 AND x2)
source.action_tape: t=0..191, c=t%8, a=(floor(t/8)%2), x=c XOR (a<<1). Each 16-step tape sees all 16 public (c,a) pairs and all 8 physical cell inputs twice; all policies receive identical actual witnessed actions and outcomes.
source.private_coin: SHA256('know33:private:coin:v1:'+seed+':'+t), first unsigned 64 bits / 2**64; shared exogenous coin for both fork worlds, no oracle labels given to policy.
source.schedule: A t0..63; deep-cold-fork at t64; control A continues t64..191; treatment B1 or B2 t64..127 then A t128..191. The fork and switches are evaluator-private; model receives only x, a, y in sequence, with no phase marker, elapsed horizon, oracle map, or future outcomes.
source.holdout: 24 new paired worlds, 12 B1 and 12 B2; no prior HELD seed identity reuse; one new synthetic first-use only after prereg+implementation+focused tests+atlas+mandatory full Linux and Windows+previous-source read-only compatibility.

models.candidate: 8 independent (slow-A,fast-B) Beta(1,1) cell pairs; 4 local adjacent two-cell support units. Each cell sees its own observed x,y. A support unit reads only its two member-cell predictions and a single local likelihood-ratio scalar updated using its observed member, clip to [-8,8], with exponential forgetting 0.8 and hysteresis. Local score starts 2; activating fast when score<-2, slow when score>+2, otherwise retain prior state. For first 6 observed samples PER CELL initialize slow Beta only and fast remains Beta(1,1). Afterward active slow cell updates only if its current single event was more likely under slow than fast; otherwise quarantine (do not modify A). Active fast cell updates only fast Beta. Every cell has exactly two Beta heads; no growing cells or replay.
models.hmm: Same 8 physical cells, each two Beta heads, first six observations per cell train slow only and leave fast Beta(1,1). Thereafter independent cell-local hidden-state probability with hazard 1/32, soft-weight evidence update of both heads after each one observed event; cannot see evaluator phase. Two heads exactly same hypothesis family, no local support communication. Both methods may record equivalent public metadata; report actual state size/CPU.
models.rolling: One Beta head per cell refit from its last eight actual observed binary consequences for that cell, with same initial Beta(1,1); smaller capacity, non-primary conventional control.
models.single: One Beta head per cell trained on all actually observed outcomes, smaller capacity and no protected state.
models.no_neighbor: Same candidate two Beta heads and thresholds, but eight independent support scalars without neighbor sharing; stricter locally informed ablation, not assumed byte-equal. All state bytes accounted.
models.capacity: Hard 8 causal cells, at most 2 Beta heads/cell, support units 4 in candidate or 8 in no-neighbor ablation, scores bounded [-8,8], no dynamic cell spawning, no global/privileged phase selector. Every method sees the same public 192 actions and consequences per fork. Record actual bytes and CPU, do not assert equal resource cost if not measured.

budgets.training: A prefix=8 witnessed consequences per physical cell, no historical FIT. Each B or A interval=8 witnessed consequences per physical cell.

metrics.primary: Expected Brier on 16 public (c,a) counterfactual queries under TRUE A law after 16 and 32 genuinely witnessed return A outcomes. Lower is better. No evaluator label enters learner.
secondary: A-law Brier just after 64 observed A events, just after B stage and after k8,16,32,64 returning A actual observations
B-stage prequential expected Brier before every B action, and end-of-B B-law expected Brier
A-only no-switch fork false support-fast activations, old-A slow-state digests immediately after A vs after B, cold replay byte and readout equality
Per-family 12 paired worlds, actual source calls, cell/state bytes, counts of local messages, wall CPU, total model comparisons
metrics.limits: This is a novel synthetic cellular memory benchmark only, not a native Yggdrasil developmental substrate, real-world causal transfer, language competence, or proof of general intelligence.

frozen.P0: Every 16-step public action tape covers all eight physical input cells twice; source and other arms observe identical public witness tapes with disjoint frozen seeds and no hidden phase labels.
frozen.P1: Mean A-law expected Brier after true 64-observation A prefix for candidate <=0.235 (substantive learned A) on both 12-world families.
frozen.H1: Candidate after 16 and 32 witnessed A-return actions has at least 0.005 lower mean A-Brier than EACH of hmm, rolling and no_neighbor, separately in BOTH 12-world B families, and wins >=9/12 per family vs hmm at k32.
frozen.H2: Candidate exact live slow-A Beta state survives B interval unchanged after first six observations per cell in >=20/24 paired worlds; frozen immutable copies alone do not count, and B-stage old-A checksum must be verified.
frozen.H3: Candidate B-stage mean prequential B-Brier <= hmm +0.005 in EACH family; protection cannot simply stop B learning.
frozen.H4: No-switch AAA false fast mode switches <=2/24 worlds; no privileged phase, duplicate/invalid event rejected, cold restore has equal bytes and 16 forecast outputs, all source/event budgets exact.
frozen.classification: SOURCE_ONLY_DEV_SUPPORTED iff P0,P1,H1,H2,H3,H4 pass; otherwise SOURCE_ONLY_DEV_NO_GO_OR_MIXED. Always SCIENTIFIC_NO_GO_NOT_NATIVE and no model promotion. If source contract/score leakage/CI fails => INVALID_ENGINEERING. Preserve negative and do not replay or retune consumed cohort.
frozen.stop: No post-first-use change to seeds, thresholds, model rules or horizons. No second HELD access. Original-world issue #426 stays blocked.
